attempts.raw: TEXT Conversation Engine manages messages and their lineage, Context Engine selects and budgets references for responses, and Application Orchestrator coordinates their interactions. To decouple them: define clear interfaces where Conversation Engine exposes message history and lineage data without internal logic; Context Engine requests message context and returns selected references with budgets, operating independently; Application Orchestrator acts as mediator, invoking Conversation Engine to get messages, passing them to Context Engine for reference selection and budgeting, then integrating results. Use asynchronous messaging or API calls to avoid tight coupling, ensure each component has single responsibility, and maintain separation of concerns for easier testing and scalability.

One Stack with unique named leaves. Up to 40 leaves, 40 collection members, 64 declarations, depth 32, 16000 UTF-8 source bytes, 10000 frame bytes. Integers for input state. Names start with ASCII letter, then alphanumeric or underscore, at most 48 characters. All declarations must be reachable. Text and labels at most 512 characters. Safe Graphic items use kind plus only required fields: rect(x,y,width,height), circle(cx,cy,r), text(x,y,text), path(d using only M L H V Z, lowercase equivalents, numbers, spaces or commas), group(items of leaves). Numeric coordinates 0..640; viewBox 0 0 450 135.
One assignment per physical line. root = Stack([leafName, otherLeaf]). Each leaf is one named call: Text("text"), Metric("label",numericValue), Control("label",literalMin,literalMax,choices,$variable), Table([{label:"name",score:number}]), Graphic("label",items). Declare $variable = integer and bind it to exactly one Control. Use [] for range or literal string options indexed 0..n-1. Derived name = expression. Strings use double quotes. Numeric + - * /, == > <, condition ? yes : no, arrays, objects, named references, @Sum(numbers), @Sort(rows,"score","desc") are allowed. No unary minus, concatenation, member access, map, interpolation or inline nested components. Produce complete root and definitions.
Choose TEXT for a simple definition. Use a legible diagram if spatial relationships aid understanding. Use controls for a changing decision. Label units, state assumptions, use short readable labels, give each output an informative name and check zero or boundary conditions. Keep geometry inside the viewBox.

attempts.raw: TEXT To decouple a Conversation Engine (managing messages and lineage), a Context Engine (selecting and budgeting references), and an Application Orchestrator (coordinating them), define clear interfaces and responsibilities: 1) Conversation Engine exposes message history and lineage via a read-only API without embedding context selection logic. 2) Context Engine receives message context, independently selects relevant references, and manages reference budgets without direct access to message internals. 3) Application Orchestrator acts as a mediator, invoking Conversation Engine to retrieve messages, passing them to Context Engine for reference selection and budgeting, then integrating and routing results. Use asynchronous communication or API calls between components to avoid tight coupling, maintain single responsibility per component, and enable independent development, testing, and scalability.
